question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He is a complete __novice__ when it comes to driving a car.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Amateur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Novice"** refers to someone who is new or inexperienced in a particular activity or field. (नवसिखुआ)

 
 
• **Example:** As a novice to programming, she decided to enroll in a beginner's coding course.
 
 
 
• **"Amateur"** means a person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport or art, on an unpaid basis or someone who is inexperienced or unskilled in a particular activity. (शौक़ीन / अनुभवहीन)
 
 
• **Example:** He is an amateur photographer and enjoys taking pictures as a hobby.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Novice"** is **"Amateur"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Amateur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Expert** (विशेषज्ञ): Someone who has a comprehensive and authoritative knowledge of or skill in a particular area.

 
 
• **Example:** She is an expert in data analysis and has been working in this field for years.
 
 
 
• **Zealous** (उत्साही): Having or showing great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause or objective.
 
 
• **Example:** The zealous volunteers worked tirelessly to help those in need after the disaster.
 
 
 
• **Swindler** (धोखेबाज): A person who cheats others, especially to make money.
 
 
• **Example:** The swindler tricked the elderly couple into giving him their savings.
